newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail shares rise on Gold Fields move.
newsitem.headline: Nail shares rise on Gold Fields move.

text.p: Shares in New Africa Investment Ltd (Nail) glistened on Thursday after the black empowerment group said it was involved in talks to take joint control of Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd, dealers said.
Nail, headed by former African National Congress secretary-general Cyril Ramaphosa, rose by 35 cents to 425 cents after the announcement.
The group said it aimed to buy an effective 17.2 percent stake in Gold Fields, the world's third largest gold producer.
"I guess they (Nail) are up on the back of the Gold Fields story. The market's reaction to it has been positive," one dealer said.
The buy will give Nail joint control of Gold Fields with the Rembrandt Group Ltd which already owns a similar stake. -- Ellis Mnyandu, Johannesburg newsroom, +27 11 482 1003
